groundTruth.summary: The chamfer fold inflates the solid into a broad bevel (top near y=+0.14, lobes reach ~0.085); the groove cutter is buried mid-span and only reaches the surface near its ±z caps, producing annular pits with a central pillar. The groove rim is a field discontinuity.
